needs_attention: Debbie Fung WON today ($7,989.14, project pipeline) — deposit paid in-store; a follow-up in-home visit is booked 2026-10-02, confirm it's for final measurements/install prep, not a duplicate consult.

Two opportunities auto-abandoned today much faster than platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json predicts (Thierry Beauvais: 8 days in '0a. New Lead' vs the 28-day rule; Noel Brillantes: ~41 days in '0b. Later Date (Warm)' vs the 80-day rule) — worth checking whether GHL's live automation has drifted from the documented config, or these skipped normal aging some other way.
Sowmya: Customer paid in full but work is unfinished 12 days after the crew left; tone has escalated to 'unprofessional' — needs a concrete repair date, not another 'someone will reach out'.
Arvind: Visit is same-day (4:30pm) and customer explicitly asked for a confirmation call beforehand.
Sean K: Outstanding balance collection in progress with 4 unread customer replies — could be a payment confirmation or a dispute, needs eyes today.
Harry (Brampton): in-home visit was cancelled 48.7 days ago with no reschedule since — sitting in Meeting-scheduled well past its 30-day window with no sequence to catch it (known workflow gap).
Mohammad Abd Bint Azi asked 'What's the final no?' (final price) on a live negotiation 7.7 days ago and never got a reply — highest-risk stale lead in the pipeline right now.

33 opportunities are at or past their stale-lead threshold without ever getting the stale_lead tag (worst: *Maria Waterdown at 283% of the Meeting-scheduled 30-day window) — the automation isn't reliably catching aging leads; see extensions.ghl.workflow_drift for the full list.

reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline currently holds 51 open/closed records seen today — retail material sales, distinct from project work. No stale thresholds defined for this pipeline; volume only, no staleness prediction. Data-quality note: 17 records sitting in 6a/6b Closed stages (all from 2025, none from today) still carry status=open rather than won/lost — the store pipeline's stage move does not always flip the opportunity status field the way the project pipeline does, so a pure status=won/lost filter alone would undercount historical store closes; today's store_wins_today=0 is unaffected since none of those 17 changed stage today.
